title: Cricket World Cups
description: The pinnacle events in international cricket — ODI and T20 formats

odi.name: ICC Cricket World Cup (ODI)
odi.description: 50-over-per-side format — the traditional World Cup held every 4 years since 1975

editions.fun_fact: Clive Lloyd scored 102 off 85 balls in the final — the first Cricket World Cup
Viv Richards scored 138 not out — one of the greatest World Cup final innings
India's greatest sporting upset — massive underdogs who beat the mighty West Indies. Kapil Dev lifted the trophy
First World Cup held outside England — Australia began their era of dominance
Imran Khan led cornered tigers Pakistan from near-elimination to victory — one of cricket's great stories
Sri Lanka's greatest day — Aravinda de Silva's 107* in the final. Jayasuriya's opening blitz changed ODI cricket forever
Australia won with 8 wickets to spare in the final — beginning their era of total dominance
Australia won by 125 runs — Ricky Ponting scored 140* in the final. The most dominant World Cup performance ever
Australia's third consecutive World Cup — an unprecedented achievement
MS Dhoni's iconic six over long-on to win the World Cup for India — 28 years after their first title. Sachin Tendulkar finally won his only World Cup
Australia won their fifth title on home soil — Mitchell Starc took 22 wickets, a World Cup record

editions.final_score: 241 each (Super Over tied, England won on boundaries)
editions.fun_fact: The most dramatic World Cup final ever — England won on boundaries after the Super Over tied too! Ben Stokes was the hero
India were unbeaten in the tournament and heavy favourites — Australia came from behind to win a stunning final

t20.name: ICC T20 World Cup
t20.description: Twenty20 format — 20 overs per side, the shortest and most explosive format, held every 2 years since 2007

editions.fun_fact: MS Dhoni asked Joginder Sharma to bowl the last over — he took the final wicket to seal India's first T20 World Cup
Pakistan won comfortably — Shahid Afridi was the star performer
England's only ICC event win in the T20 era — Craig Kieswetter was player of the tournament
Marlon Samuels top-scored with 78 and Gayle's 33 helped West Indies cruise to victory
Sri Lanka's only T20 World Cup — Kumar Sangakkara bowed out a champion
Carlos Brathwaite hit 4 sixes in the last over off Ben Stokes to win it for West Indies — one of cricket's most dramatic finishes!
Australia's first ever T20 World Cup title — David Warner was man of the match in the final
Sam Curran won Player of the Tournament with his yorker-heavy bowling attack
India's second T20 World Cup — Virat Kohli scored 76 in the final. India went unbeaten throughout the tournament
